Sources & model accuracy

Geometry comes from the official December 2022 STEP assembly; PCB artwork from the February 2023 manufacturing files. The Wi-Fi package, connector inserts, substrate and markings include reconstructed details. Small revision differences may exist. Materials are a studio rendering of the hardware.

Pin names, pads, vias and trace routes come from the official Altium PCB export. X-ray highlights follow copper layers; plane fills and copper pours are not included. The export can differ from the assembly revision. Distributor links search the published part number; availability is not verified.
